utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still lining up helpers for Saturday, and I’m a bit worried about whether we’ll have enough hands on the porch. Can you help me check who’s available?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive on Saturday at the front porch. I can help for a while, just remind me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you can bring a screwdriver set, a few wrenches, and maybe some work gloves, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you, Rosa! Come by the front porch at 9 a.m., and if you can bring a toolbox and a good pair of gloves, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still looking for a few handy folks to help out on Saturday at the front porch. If you know anyone who can lend a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds good to me. I can help keep it simple on Saturday, and I’m happy to bring whatever you need.

utterances.text: Vik: I’m organizing a repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I still need a few helpers. Can you lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I could use the help. If you’re free Saturday at the front porch, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — if you’re free Saturday, I’d really appreciate you pitching in on the front porch repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
